title: God becomes man becomes fish becomes barnacle goose becomes featherbed mountain.
html_source:
Debated; transformations of spirituality.

God becomes man = Jesus

Man becomes fish = Symbol for Christianity

Fish becomes barnacle goose = Taken from the medieval belief that Geese were born from barnacles. Being feathered they eventually take free flight (from Christianity).

Barnacle Goose becomes featherbed mountain = Death, given the rejection of Christianity and hence “eternal” life.

This dark analysis is given a more positive light in the previous annotation, whereby Ariel sings not of God saving Alonso’s soul but of the sea making something beautiful of his drowned body.
